messages:
IncidentBot: [pager] HIGH latency spike on /v1/generate across eu-west-1 — 3xx token failures, elevated p99; paging oncall team (severity: P1). link: https://redwood.inc/alerts/INC-2350004321
Maya (oncall): saw it, joining bridge. starting mitigation now.
Maya (oncall): quick check — is traffic skewed to a single model or variant?
Ravi: looks like the quantized-2 model instance in eu-west-1 hit OOMs and restarted a few pods, GC churn reported.
Maya (oncall): copying logs to the bridge. running hotfix: revert to cpu-backed fallback pool for the affected routing rule.
Maya (oncall): hotfix applied; traffic rerouted, callers see 80% drop in errors, p95 improving. continuing observation.
OpsBot: deploy bot reports: rollback of route redirection completed at 2350004580, rollout 100% to fallback.
Sanjay: good, thanks. ping if anything customer-facing.
Maya (oncall): customer impact: a subset of enterprise calls in EU saw 5-10s latency and some truncated responses between 2350004200-2350004600. no data leakage. I flagged accounts with dedicated capacity for follow-up.
Ellie P.: thanks — can we get a list of impacted customers for comms? I can draft a status note.
Maya (oncall): added export to ticket INC-2350004321 -> /tickets/2350; included traces and sample requests (IDs redacted).
Sanjay: creating postmortem thread and scheduling writeup. proposing postmortem meeting Thu 10:00 UTC.
Taylor: I'm available Thu. I'll do peer review then.
Maya (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall for monitoring and RCA. Ravi, you're up for the writeup draft?
Ravi: I can take the draft. planning to include timeline, contributing factors, mitigation steps, and proposed action items.
Maya (oncall): ok handover notes:
- root cause: quant-2 model worker experienced memory regression after kernel update -> increased memory footprint -> OOM restarts
- immediate mitigation: route to cpu fallback + autoscale temp bump
- customer impact window: 2350004200-2350004600
- evidence: logs, pod events, heap dumps (sanitized) linked in ticket
- recommended next steps: revert kernel change in staging, add memory regressions to preflight, increase OOM alert sensitivity
Sanjay: adding these to the postmortem template.
Ravi: starting draft now. pulling timeline from logs. snippet:
```
2350004178 - Autoscaler reported high mem usage on quant-2-7
2350004196 - Pod quant-2-7 OOMKilled, restart
2350004205 - Traffic spike rerouted by smart-router to remaining replicas
2350004212 - Error rate rose to 12% on /v1/generate (eu-west-1)
2350004580 - Manual route rollback to cpu-fallback completed
2350004623 - Error rate returned to baseline
```
Taylor: looks good. when you have the first draft ping @Ellie P. and me for review. I'll focus on ops/mitigation section.
Ellie P.: I'll draft the customer note once timeline + affected accounts list is attached. small ask: include exact hostnames and sample trace IDs in the evidence bundle (sanitized).
Sanjay: created doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2350004321-draft — set permissions to ops-team + eng-infra + legal.
Maya (oncall): quick action item list from bridge (assigning owners):
- A1: Add memory regression tests to model onboarding (owner: Ravi)
- A2: Adjust OOM alert thresholds for quantized workers (owner: Taylor)
- A3: Update routing fallback docs and automation (owner: Sanjay)
- A4: Customer comms draft (owner: Ellie P.)
- A5: Postmortem writeup (owner: Ravi)
Ravi: acknowledged A1/A5, will start work and link PRs. target: draft in 48h.
Taylor: acknowledged A2, will propose threshold and run a short spike test in staging. target: 72h.
Sanjay: acknowledged A3, will add automation runbook and test the rollback path. target: 1 week.
Ellie P.: acknowledged A4, will draft and route to comms/legal once impacted list is attached. target: start within 24h.
Maya (oncall): tagging legal: @legal for review of customer note, please advise if any wording concerns.
IncidentBot: auto-note: postmortem meeting scheduled Thu 10:00 UTC (calendar: https://cal.redwood/meet/pm-2350).
Ellie P.: quick Q on severity: should we classify as "P1 brief" or "P2 with customer impact" in the header?
Sanjay: I'd keep P1 until writeup confirms limited scope — better to be conservative.
Taylor: agree. label P1 in header and note limited impact in summary.
Ravi: draft uploaded to doc at 2350006000. added timeline and initial contributing factors.
Maya (oncall): thanks. handing off — I'm available for followups but stepping out of night shift.
OpsBot: reminder: add retrospective checklist items to the postmortem doc (automated).
Ellie P.: reviewed draft at 2350007000, left comments on mitigation clarity and customer list missing one enterprise account.
Ravi: fixed comments and pushed update at 2350008220.
Taylor: peer review completed at 2350008800 — left a few wording suggestions; everything else LGTM.
Ellie P.: legal reviewed and cleared wording at 2350009000. no issues.
Sanjay: final sign-off requested — @Taylor can you sign the RCA and close the loop?
Taylor: signed off at 2350009123 :white_check_mark: — moving postmortem to "published" and creating follow-up tickets for action items.
Maya (oncall): thanks all. closing this thread.
IncidentBot: postmortem published: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2350004321-draft (status: published)
